name: osw-jupyternaut
description: Wires the in-browser Jupyternaut agent to the OpenSemanticLab wiki it is served from

scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:labextension
scripts.test:unit: tsc src/wiki.ts src/bridge.ts --outDir .test-build --module commonjs --target es2020 --skipLibCheck --lib es2020,dom && WIKI_JS=$PWD/.test-build/wiki.js BRIDGE_JS=$PWD/.test-build/bridge.js node tests/wiki_unit.cjs && WIKI_JS=$PWD/.test-build/wiki.js BRIDGE_JS=$PWD/.test-build/bridge.js node tests/save_order.cjs
